label: OPEN reading of ST I q.3 a.5 ad 2: for every pair of beings, x's represented degree is at most y's…
paraphrase: OPEN reading of ST I q.3 a.5 ad 2 (unumquodque tantum habet de esse, quantum ei appropinquat): for every pair of beings, x's represented degree is at most y's exactly when x approaches the primary at most as nearly as y.
